reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts, which is outside the accepted set (NY, DE, CA, England and Wales) and near the walk-away position of foreign law with exclusive foreign venue.

The redline implements the preferred position exactly (New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York County) and preserves the sentence skeleton ('This Agreement is governed exclusively by ... and the ... courts ... have exclusive jurisdiction'), consistent with the rule's instruction to replace only the jurisdiction and forum words.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.789 changed-character ratio) is an artifact of a short sentence in which nearly all substantive words are jurisdiction/forum references; no unrelated terms, and neither 28.2 nor 28.3 were touched.

The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the change and the conflict with Section 28.2, and offers the sanctioned fallbacks (Delaware/California, or England and Wales with London courts).
Severity of medium is consistent with the rule's stated severity; the internal conflict with the already-agreed New York venue in 28.2 does not warrant escalation since the edit resolves it.
